introHtml: Custom PL dog tags offer a durable, lightweight solution for identification and branding. Whether you need luggage tags for corporate travel gifts or pet ID tags for a veterinary practice, the PL material provides a sleek finish that accepts vibrant screen printing or debossing. These tags are perfect for tradeshows, employee badges, or membership cards where a professional look matters. Choose from shapes like round bag tags or classic dog tag silhouettes to match your brand.
